metadata.description: Minimalist personal profile and digital portfolio.

intro.headline: Systems that run your business.
intro.description: <1>Custom sites and systems</1> — from booking to payments — running under your own brand. No matter the size of the problem: small businesses or projects at scale, always the <1>right solution</1>.

core.headline: Context dictates the engineering.
core.description: Anchored by a robust TypeScript ecosystem [<1>Next.js, NestJS</1>], the infrastructure is strictly tailored to the real needs of the business. Every tool is selected to solve specific bottlenecks, governed by SOLID principles and Clean Architecture.

workflow.headline: your business, analyzed. a solution built to fit.
workflow.description: Premium interfaces operating on industrial foundations. I translate business models into high-conversion experiences, executing and controlling the entire engineering cycle: from architectural scope to continuous deployment.

neatnest.description: An intelligent system for domestic and professional inventory control and management. Full-stack engineering [<1>NestJS, Prisma, Angular and SCSS</1>] connecting a modern PWA to a solid bespoke backend, with database hosted on <2>Supabase</2>.

codifylab.description: The intelligent proprietary system that manages and controls your business and digital identity in an advanced way. Full integration with your website, mobile app, and online store. Create, edit, and delete <1>services</1>, manage <1>appointments and reservations</1>, set your <1>business hours and days off</1>, in real time.

origin.headline: Industrial discipline. Scalable engineering.
origin.description: Over a decade forged by the rigor of Japanese industry. A foundation of discipline that, in the last {{devYears}} years, has been fully channeled into the mastery of software engineering. B.S. in Computer Science, fusing deep engineering fundamentals with practical research.
